steps.title: Prepare reaction mix
steps.instruction: Assemble the RT‑PCR reaction using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies, Catalog #11732088) following the kit’s recommended component volumes and concentrations.

steps.title: Run thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Place the reaction tubes in the real‑time PCR instrument and apply the following cycling program: 50 °C for 5 min (1 X), 95 °C for 2 min (1 X), then 95 °C for 3 sec followed by 40 cycles of 60 °C for 30 sec each.

substeps.instruction: Amplification: 95 °C, 3 sec then 60 °C, 30 sec for 40 cycles.

steps.title: Interpret amplification results
steps.instruction: A satisfactory positive result must show a sigmoidal amplification curve with fluorescence intensity above that of the positive control, a clear threshold (C_T) crossing early in the log‑linear phase, and a C_T value ≤ 40 cycles; any sample with C_T > 40 cycles is considered negative, and no‑template controls (NTCs) must not produce a curve.
